title: US lawmakers ask Trump administration to stop deportation of Afghans
summary:
The Trump administration has forcibly sent at least 25,000 people to third countries, according to a tally by nonprofits Refugees International and Human Rights First.
Since taking office, Trump has attempted to put an end to resettlement programmes for Afghans started by former President Joe Biden.
The Trump administration has instituted record-low quotas for asylum applications globally.
Trump ordered a halt to processing applications from Afghans after a man from Afghanistan allegedly shot two National Guardsmen in Washington, DC, in November 2025.
The Trump administration also included Afghan nationals in a blanket visa ban earlier this year, saying it would review immigration applications filed by anyone from the country.

title: Why Immigration Agents Don’t Quit in Protest
summary:
Much of the outcry stirred by the harsh policies of the first Trump Administration was quelled by Joe Biden’s promise of a more measured approach.
Still, there was a feeling among immigration agents that they were being shackled by the new Administration.
By 2024, the Border Patrol had lost a quarter of its workforce, with many longtime agents opting for early retirement.
The operation was so unpopular with the rank and file that Border Patrol and ICE struggled to find personnel for the deployment.
“We can’t always support what happens just because it’s one of us,” a Border Patrol agent had told a private group chat in the wake of Pretti’s killing.

title: 13 Foreign Nationals Arrested for Selling Fake Immigration Services
summary:
Thirteen foreign nationals were arrested this month and charged for a scheme to defraud migrants by selling fake immigration legalization services to help them gain lawful status.
Legacy would falsify immigration documents to fraudulently obtain immigration status and benefits for their clients.
A recent article at Substack revealed an entire industry of fraudulent immigration services, some using fake AI representatives in videos posted to TikTok, to rip off vulnerable migrants on services that will never be provided.
In other news, a large chain launched by a woman who was hailed as a top immigration lawyer was busted for fraudulent legal services.
Further, Vinod Doddamani is facing a proposed $250,000 fine after investigators alleged he submitted 64 fraudulent documents across 32 separate immigration cases.

title: Trump Rewrites Obama's Immigration History In Bizarre Rant
summary:
